title: Phase 2 identity reconciliation boundary
summary: Source-local person, customer, employee, supplier, store and business-entity IDs have no cross-demo or real-world identity. Customer/supplier/employer/operator are roles; organisation, legal entity, site and registration differ. A native PK/FK supports only its declared source relationship. Alternate unique names/GUIDs are source-scoped; names are not LEI/ROR/ORCID or a portable person key.
